explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/802: AEKS proved an independent set of size ≫_r (log log(t+1) / t)·n. The Lean statement: ∀ r, ∃ c > 0, ∀ n and K_r-free G on Fin n, c·(log(log(t+1))/t)·n ≤ indepNum G. For small t the expression log log(t+1) is negative (or the quotient is 0 when t = 0), so the inequality is trivially true there and the statement is correct for all graphs. Faithful.
